articles.title: Bypassing the red tape: Ludhiana MSMEs get direct line to govt bids
articles.description: GeM Facilitation Centre launched in Ludhiana to help MSMEs and local firms register, list products and join government procurement via the GeM portal.

articles.title: NHAI extends northern RRR tender deadline to September 23
articles.description: The NHAI has extended the tender deadline for the northern part of Telangana's Regional Ring Road to September 23. The 161-km Sangareddy-Choutuppal stretch has faced repeated bidding delays, with Cabinet approval from the Centre still reportedly pending

articles.title: ACB court remands Pankaj Verma for two days in DJB STP tender scam
articles.description: A Rouse Avenue Court sent Srijanhar Enterprises proprietor Pankaj Verma to two days’ ACB custody in the alleged Delhi Jal Board STP tender scam.
